name: Self-Directed Dimension / Self-Directed Queries Complexity
details: For every concept class (and, in particular, every finite binary class in this catalogue), $\mathrm{SDdim}(\mathcal H)=\mathrm M_{\mathrm{sd}}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: Theorem 1 of Devulapalli--Hanneke proves that the minimax labelling-game value, equivalently the maximum realizable self-directed-tree depth, equals the optimal self-directed mistake bound.
